content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed in response to the verifier:**

- Added a third surgical replace to §15.10.2.2 (p0827): the unqualified mandate *"Any Dispute including the determination of the scope or applicability of this agreement to arbitrate, shall be determined by the ICDR..."* now opens *"Where the Parties have agreed in writing to arbitrate under Section 15.10.2.1, such Dispute shall be determined by the ICDR..."*. This both subordinates the ICDR process to the opt-in gate and removes the competence-competence delegation that could have been invoked against the new Delaware court submission.
- The forum is now internally consistent: exclusive Delaware state and federal court jurisdiction in §15.10.1, with the retained ICDR machinery operating only on mutual written agreement.
- Coverage rebuilt: governing-law element remains `already_met` on untouched §15.9 (Delaware); the forum element is now `addressed_by_operation` across operations 1–3.
- The vestigial IP carve-out to "a U.S. federal court of appropriate jurisdiction" was deliberately left verbatim (minimality) and is expressly acknowledged in the rationale as a limited-subject-matter carve-out we do not treat as defeating the Delaware merits forum. The comment no longer overstates the effect of the edit.
